verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right flow: headline, then CTA, then product and logo. But the CTA pill is huge and outweighs the headline. The body copy and badge pills are unreadably tiny. The rotated SUNSET SALE ribbon collides with the missing-asset placeholder, and the legal text is crammed into a narrow right column. B is worse. The headline is squeezed into 5 lines. The middle is a jumbled pile: the product, the logo, a microscopic single-line body copy, illegible pills, a SUNSET SALE badge tossed in at an angle among the pills, and the legal text and placeholder all run together. It has no grid and no grouping, and much of its text can't be read.
